related_questions.question: Is the Pfizer COVID shot an mRNA?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine is an mRNA vaccine, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and the Mayo Clinic. It uses messenger RNA (mRNA) to instruct cells to produce a harmless piece of the SARS-CoV-2 virus (the spike protein), which then triggers an immune response. This is the same type of vaccine as Moderna's COVID-19 vaccine.
